title: Canonical Action and Integrated Response Source Correlation
changes: The existing method response AST projection interface now requires canonical action publications from the same controller artifact.
The upstream projection correlates action identity and exact source file/start/end span before producing response AST output.
Missing and ambiguous action correlations are explicit rejected judgments; rejected products do not produce ResponseAst values.
The response scanner forwards existing action publications and retains projection judgments without adding a parallel authority.
open_obligations: responseAttributeScanner still resolves DTO classes and merges observed return fields
legacy response descriptor compatibility projection has not been retired
resource binding domain publication still traverses the legacy action adapter
remaining semantic/relations usages require call-by-call tracing

validation.syntax_transpilation: 3/3 changed TypeScript source files passed with zero syntax diagnostics
